title: Sanjay Leela Bhansali Ditches Teaser for Immersive Love & War Launch in August
excerpt: The filmmaker is personally shaping a special promotional asset to introduce audiences to the world of his upcoming film starring Ranbir Kapoor, Alia Bhatt, and Vicky Kaushal.
body:
• Sanjay Leela Bhansali will skip a conventional teaser or motion poster for Love & War, opting for an immersive promotional experience instead
  • The special asset is in its final stages and is expected to be unveiled in August, marking the start of the film's marketing campaign
  • Love & War stars Ranbir Kapoor, Alia Bhatt, and Vicky Kaushal, making it one of the most anticipated Bollywood films of the year
  • The film recently completed a grand song shoot with 200 dancers at Royal Palms in Mumbai

Breaking the Bollywood Playbook

https://youtube.com/watch?v=gy4REzezkyE

Sanjay Leela Bhansali has never been one for the conventional, and his approach to launching Love & War confirms it. According to an exclusive report by Bollywood Hungama, the filmmaker's upcoming period romantic drama will not begin its promotional journey with the standard teaser-then-trailer formula that defines virtually every major Bollywood release.

Instead, Bhansali is personally overseeing the creation of what is being described as an "immersive experience" — a promotional asset designed to transport audiences into the film's emotional and visual world before a single full trailer drops.

What We Know About the Launch

Details remain tightly held, but industry sources say the asset is in its final stages of development. Bhansali is working closely with his creative team to ensure the result meets his exacting standards.

https://x.com/Bollyhungama/status/2082419238875328560

"Instead of a standard promotional launch, they are developing a special asset that will serve as the audience's first introduction to the film. Conceived as an immersive experience, the asset will be personally shaped by Sanjay Leela Bhansali."

— Industry source, via Bollywood Hungama

The plan is to unveil the asset sometime in August, which would mark the official start of Love & War's marketing campaign. By bypassing character posters and conventional teasers entirely, the aim is to create an event-like atmosphere — a first glimpse that functions less as a clip and more as a sensory introduction to the film's scale and mood.

The Film Behind the Hype

Love & War brings together three of Bollywood's biggest names: Ranbir Kapoor, Alia Bhatt, and Vicky Kaushal. The casting alone makes it one of the year's most talked-about projects. Bhansali, whose filmography includes Padmaavat, Bajirao Mastani, and the Netflix series Heeramandi, is known for lavish visual storytelling and meticulous period detail.

The film has been shooting through 2026, with a large-scale song sequence involving 200 dancers recently filmed at Royal Palms in Mumbai. Reports suggest the film may target a Diwali 2026 release window, though no official date has been announced.

Other major productions have been clearing the path — Rishab Shetty's Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj reportedly shifted its release to avoid clashing with Love & War, a sign of the film's anticipated commercial dominance.

A Strategy Worth Watching

The immersive launch approach is unusual for Indian cinema, where teaser-trailer-poster cascades remain the entrenched marketing formula. If Bhansali pulls it off, it could set a new template for how tentpole Bollywood films introduce themselves to audiences — particularly in an era where attention spans are short and traditional promotional clips can feel disposable.

For the Indian diaspora, Love & War represents exactly the kind of prestige Bollywood event film that drives theatrical demand abroad. How Bhansali chooses to build anticipation will be as closely watched as the film itself.
nri_angle: Love & War is a prestige Bollywood event film expected to drive significant theatrical demand among diaspora audiences worldwide.
